39031.rationale: Independent variation-only reconsideration of b001-b010 across all three seeds, not a new per-record or global correctness decision. I read the complete supplied frozen-context projection, including full protocol/rubric text, the full variation packet, its original rationale chunks and all 30 supplied full-raw-row identity proofs. The original exhaustive actual-field observations remain the substantive evidence; matching observation signatures alone are not semantic proof. The packet reports no post-review actual changes for these 30 pairs, and its C-provided proofs assert V4 rows byte-identical to the originally reviewed V2 rows. I checked exact pair coverage and the original review/context artifact hashes, but did not independently reopen the raw corpus files. Frozen protocol describes seeds as independent prose/length/completeness/distribution/publisher realizations with identical canonical relevance facts, not repeated observations from a single fixed physical experiment. Frozen metadata variation expressly permits reassigned publishers and spatial neutrality. The rubric defines the f01 facts as measured wet friction coefficient, surface roughness mm and water-film depth mm, without a numerical success threshold. Thus my earlier requirement that illustrative numeric examples and fictional sites/publishers be identical was stricter than the frozen canonical claim-preservation requirement. The actual changed values remain documented: b001 distributions.0.description has 'tested pavement surface roughness (mm; e.g. 1.68)', 'wet sliding friction coefficient (dimensionless; e.g. 0.56)' and 'water-film depth on pavement (mm; e.g. 1.71)', versus 1.65/0.53/1.28 and 1.41/0.57/0.68 in the other seeds. These are different positive illustrative wet-test quantities in the same units, not a switch to dry testing, a missing column or a threshold violation. No blanket rule that any changed number is harmless is adopted. All measured quantities in these shoe records were checked for the same variable/unit association, and no frozen exact numeric condition applies to them. Fixed identity claims are distinct from illustrations: b001 description states 'The catalogue model or edition is RUN-X120. Its declared catalogue aliases are run-x120 and RUNX120.' That string/alias policy, full-shoe role, and the I/1, O/0, prefix, suffix and version distinctions of b002-b010 persist. b001/b002/b007/b008 retain three wet-test columns, b003/b009 two, b004/b010 friction only, b005 component inspection/identity/month, and b006 commercial price/carton data only. No omission or negation is credited as a positive measurement. Meaningful variation was observed in titles, order, paragraphing, lengths, optional fields and distributions, not only fictional place replacements. Across the three seeds all ten descriptions have a word-count range of at least 10 (smallest b007: 15), and all ten change distribution count. All supplied CSV/PDF synopses consistently associate formats with the same supported per-record columns; extra distributions repeat supported facts. These local counts do not certify corpus-wide quotas, title-template frequencies or length-band proportions. Under the actual frozen canonical constraints, seed-39031 variation is defensible; the prior stricter numeric/context interpretation is explicitly superseded only for variation, with its original rationale retained unchanged. Metadata association, not actual download bytes, was checked; literal paraphrase equivalence, other records and broader semantic disputes remain outside this adjudication.

39032.rationale: Independent variation-only judgment for the ten seed-39032 pairs compared with 39031 and 39033. The complete frozen protocol/rubric projection establishes preservation of canonical product/process/measurement coverage, constraints and identities across independent synthetic realizations; it does not require every illustrative dimension, price, site or publisher to be identical. The supplied full-row equality proofs cover all 30 originally exhaustively reviewed rows and report no intervening changed fields. I rely on those supplied proofs for V4 continuity, not on independent rehashing of raw corpus rows. My earlier false judgment rested on a stricter requirement for numerical/context equality, not observed loss of canonical measurement coverage; that requirement is withdrawn on this documented frozen-context basis, not by changing record observations. For the specific previously flagged b005 variation, distributions.0.description documents 'physical specification inspection (dimensions in mm; e.g. 101.28)' versus 63.03 and 70.66 in the other seeds. Its description still states 'The catalogue model or edition is RUN-X120-SOLE.' and 'This record documents the sole assembly component only, not the complete parent running shoe.' The measured dimension remains positive and in mm, while the authoritative SKU and component role are literally unchanged; there is no frozen dimensional eligibility cutoff for that component. The edition-code column remains RUN-X120-SOLE and reporting interval remains calendar month 2024-06, rather than treating identity codes or dates as freely interchangeable numbers. For b006 the commercial examples 84.76 versus 244.89/206.41 AUD/unit and carton lengths 281 versus 132/157 mm retain the same positive cost/dimension columns. Its description explicitly says 'This is an observed commercial ledger associated with the activity, not a report of experimental performance.' That exclusion remains decisive in every seed; changed price/carton values cannot become wet-friction, roughness or water-film measurements. For the true wet-test records, all friction examples are positive dimensionless values, pavement roughness and film depth examples remain positive mm measurements, and no actual f01 minimum/maximum or fixed site/publisher criterion appears in the frozen rubric. By contrast, the rubric does impose a specific -20 to +5 C condition for temperature-probe calibration; none of these ten shoe/component/ledger records documents that process, so no analogy is used to waive such a hard numeric condition. All ten scalar model identities, b001 aliases, whole-product/component distinction, empirical-versus-commercial distinction and per-ID present/absent measurement sets remain as originally observed. Distribution content and format associations remain consistent: CSV descriptions specify comma-separated tables, PDF descriptions specify document tables, and optional extra distributions repeat each record's supported columns. Seed-39032 has genuinely different clause order, description lengths, titles and optional/distribution allocation, while every packet ID changes description length by at least 10 words between some pair of seeds and every packet ID changes distribution count. Local evidence supports meaningful variation, not certification of global generation quotas or file bytes. This judgment does not clear any local semantic dispute or certify query paraphrases, full-corpus coverage or rankings. Original and scalar-identity artifacts remain immutable; only the earlier seed-variation conclusion is superseded.

39033.rationale: Independent variation-only reconsideration for all ten seed-39033 pairs using my original complete field review, the full supplied global frozen protocol/rubric and the C-provided complete 30-row byte-equality proof packet. There are no supplied intervening actual field changes for this scope; the supplied V4 source references bind the intended current artifacts, but I have not separately inspected or rehashed their raw corpus bytes. They are not numerical paraphrases, but the actual frozen requirement is canonical relevance-fact preservation across independent synthetic realizations, not identical observational samples. No fixed friction, roughness or film-depth cutoff, geographic preference, particular publisher or fixed illustrative sample value is registered for these shoe records. Positive film depth remains documented only where originally present; it is not invented for b003, b004, b009 or b010 from generic wet-testing wording. Actual fixed strings and roles do not change: b003 remains RUN-X210, b004 TRAIL-X120, b007 RUN-XI20, b008 RUN-X12O, b009 RUN-X120-V2, b010 RUN-X120-V1, b001 RUN-X120 with its explicit case/hyphen aliases, b002 RUN-X121, b005 RUN-X120-SOLE component-only, and b006 RUN-X1200 commercial ledger. b005 remains documentation/release inspection, not whole-shoe traction testing; b006 retains the explicit non-performance ledger qualification, so commercial example changes cannot supply the required wet-test facts. The original empirical basis, column-type/units coverage, missing-column patterns and format/content associations are preserved for each ID. Frozen CSV requirements for other intents and the calibration range requirement are not treated as optional; they simply are not changed or newly implicated by these shoe/component realizations. Every actual supplied distribution synopsis was checked in the original full review: CSV wording and PDF wording match format labels and repeat supported per-record measurements, without claiming additional columns in extra distributions. Textual variation is substantive: descriptions range over different sentence ordering, paragraphs and length, titles change, optional spatial coverage differs and every packet ID changes distribution count; all ten description word-count ranges across the seeds exceed or equal 10. Corpus-wide quotas and template-frequency totals cannot be certified from ten IDs. My prior false conclusion demanded unchanged illustrative numbers and fictional context without a corresponding frozen eligibility condition. On the actual frozen requirements that extra criterion is not defensible, so the semantic seed-variation judgment is now true for this scope, while the older rationale and all record observations remain historically unchanged. This is not approval of arbitrary numeric changes, underlying file contents, query equivalence, unresolved per-record semantics elsewhere or global corpus correctness.
